title: Optional Finance Code for a product type
description: GovStore metadata payload for one product type (adopted native category). One row per product type; the owner is derived from category governance. Products/models inherit through category_id. No native schema or model changes.

gov_code.description: Optional. NULL or no row means the product type has no Finance default. A supplied code must be an active Finance item whose unspsc_code is NULL or equals the product type's single UNSPSC code.

x-storage.subject_id: Product-type category ID resolved from the authorized create/edit operation
x-storage.unique: (subject_type, subject_id, namespace): exactly one default per product type
x-storage.scope: global governance or no governance row -> national/0; company governance -> company/created_by_company_id; re-derived on every read

x-unspsc: A product type has exactly one UNSPSC code (UNIQUE gov_catalog_snipe_mappings.category_id). Changing it marks a conflicting default needs_review; GRN ignores a needs_review default until the owner confirms or clears it.
x-concurrency: Update requires the expected current row revision outside the stored payload.

x-authorization.company: Existing scoped product-type edit for the owning company
x-authorization.office: Read-only; offices never override a product-type default

x-ui.placement: Directly under the product type's UNSPSC commodity on create/edit
x-ui.options: Active items whose unspsc_code equals the type's code first (marked 'matches UNSPSC'), then active items without UNSPSC; items linked to another UNSPSC are not offered
x-ui.empty: Allowed; blank removes the row; never blocks saving
x-ui.read_only_state: Shows the value and names the owner when the viewer cannot edit
x-ui.needs_review_state: Warning with confirm/clear actions for the owner
x-ui.effect_copy: New receipts of this type get Govt. Tags.

x-grn: Resolve model -> category -> default. A valid default shows read-only in the GRN line tag panel. No default (or needs_review) shows a warning with a fix: choose a code for this line or keep standard tags. Units without a Finance Code get standard tags; never blocks.
